g.title: session
g.text: DFM.4 — Session and location selection | owner approved 2026-11-01

g.title: pending
g.text: Wait for startup and activation to settle
No active session; no checkpoint retained yet

g.title: active
g.text: Retain settled checkpoint; show debug menu

g.title: restore
g.text: Invalidate session work; restore checkpoint once
Clear session and overlay; discard checkpoint

g.title: load
g.text: Load chosen location; close location menu

g.title: fail
g.text: Keep failure visible; do not claim it loaded

g.title: note
g.text: Ownership rule: late capture, picker result or exit
must not reopen debug, activate a catalog, change
selected time or restore over an ordinary action.
Search/edit/open alone does not end debug.
